== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 11 November 2018. The Facebook photo viewer names Bas Van Zuilen. Comments address him as Bas. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 62 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Zoetermeer, Neth; printed Bas Van Zulien). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/bas.vanzuilen (Lives in Veghel; From Lieshout; married to Steffie van Zuilen - Visser). The uncropped original is a three-person family photograph; the lead crop is van Zuilen alone. Tongue-out is not an obscene gesture.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Bas van Zuilen portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Bas van Zuilen Facebook portrait.jpg]].
